sprite.purpose: Create a bounded RGBA sprite canvas, initial layer, palette and frame duration.

layer.purpose: Add a named editable sprite layer.

pixel.purpose: Write one RGBA pixel at a declared layer, frame and coordinate.

rect.purpose: Fill a bounded pixel rectangle with one RGBA colour.

circle.purpose: Fill a raster circle using the adaptor raster convention.

tag.purpose: Name an inclusive animation-frame range and playback direction.

importImage.purpose: Import captured RGBA8 PNG artwork into a named editable cel with exact dimensions and pixel replacement.

examples.purpose: Import a captured badge into two editable frames with a lower background and later procedural highlight.

application.label: Aseprite
application.purpose: Create editable pixel-art sprites and timed animations from procedural drawing and captured PNG artwork; publish exact-pixel previews and sprite sheets.
